annotation.title_clean: Understanding the impact of artificial intelligence on skills development
annotation.title_en: Understanding the impact of artificial intelligence on skills development
annotation.authors_or_issuer: UNESCO-UNEVOC International Centre for TVET (written by Shiohira, K.)
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: UNESCO-UNEVOC report synthesizing research on AI's effects on intermediate-skill labour markets and TVET. It reviews national AI policies, ethics frameworks, skills needs and AI in teaching, structured around the Beijing Consensus, and recommends governance and TVET integration steps. Robotics appears only in passing.
key_provisions_or_claims: Intermediate-skill jobs face hollowing out through automation of routine tasks.
Most national AI policies prioritise development over mitigating workplace disruption.
TVET institutions should build AI literacy, ethics and digital/transversal skills.
Ethical AI requires attention to equal access, diversity, bias, safety and data agency.
Recommends international and national governance steps for integrating AI into TVET.
